member.name: T:SysWeaver.Script.CsScript
member.summary: Compiles C# source code (with Roslyn) into a collectible assembly and exposes its static Main method as a function. The source code is the body of a static class (in the namespace "CsScript"), it must contain a static method "Main" with a single parameter of the input type (found with the default binder, so a parameter type that the input type widens to, ex: long for int, is accepted too). The script can use the namespaces of some default types (System, System.Linq, System.Collections.Generic, System.Collections.Concurrent, System.IO, System.Threading, System.Threading.Tasks, System.Runtime), of the input and result types and of the supplied types. All assemblies loaded from a file into the process are referenced. Scripts run with the full permissions of the process, only run trusted code
